title: I met you in my world... i want to be friends IRL ! Are you here?
content: Hiii i figured to make this post because why not give this a shot.. And you were so kind to me... Ok so last night in my dream (me: late 20s blonde female and You: Late 20s, brown hair in ponytail, thin, Female )..we met while I was on my way to a doctor's appointment which I was walking to, and it was raining and the ground was very very muddy. I was walking past your house you have a 3 or 4 year old son who was very nosy lol. But you offered to drive me to my dr appointment and while waiting for you to get ready you invited me inside, and your son yelled saying that I got mud from my shoes on your pristine white carpet and I felt so badly. You said it wasnt a big deal and laughed and said your son is so messy he shouldn't be telling on me for bringing mud inside lol anyways I know this is weird but you were so friendly and kind and I wanted to thank you for being so nice and that would be awesome if youre on here!! Tysm for reading this as well 💓
